model_specific_risks.risk: Campbell Hausfeld HU200099AV (20-gallon) recall (Jun 17, 2009): the thermal overload, which shuts the unit off when it overheats, can fail, so internal components can melt and start a fire. Sold Jan to Jun 2009 at Wal-Mart. The recall remedy was a full refund at Wal-Mart, not a repair. Whether any remedy is still open is UNKNOWN. (Model taken from the listing text; not verified against the unit.)
model_specific_risks.source: CPSC: Campbell Hausfeld Recalls Air Compressors Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Wal-Mart, recall date Jun 17, 2009 <https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2009/Campbell-Hausfeld-Recalls-Air-Compressors-Due-to-Fire-Hazard-Sold-Exclusively-at-Wal-Mart> (retrieved 2026-10-07)

plan.value: Budget about $60 in parts and $10 in materials plus about 2 h of your time (a category estimate; the fault is not diagnosed yet). Even with no parts spend this fails your $40/h floor and the minimum profit. Sell target is $240, the median of 3 sold comparables. The recall remedy was a refund, not a repair, so any repair cost on the overload circuit is yours.
